page.layout: One page of verse, single column, centred running head above the text; no margin notes; no catchword or signature.

main_text.p: Sumit: quin potius certo Pater ordine fontes Castigat patiens, & vellit sedulus aurem. At deploratis prorsum iam rebus, & omni Maturo scelerum Autumno, ferus omnia falce Demetit irata, gentémque & nomina delet.

His agedùm monitis, maior prudentia surgat Iam tibi, quinetiam vigilum tibi cura tuorum Cautior accedat, studiúmque fidésque Senatûs. Heu, spe�To Das quæ regna modò & quas obruit vrbes Impia nox, lucis faciem mentita beatæ, Tot grauidas licet imperiis, belloque potentes, Florentes vrbes opibus? Circumspice porrò Quàm magnas sterilis passim occulit herba ruinas, Et desolatos sterilis rubus occupat agros. Aspice tot claros populos, tot regna, tot vrbes Argolicas, Rhodon, aut Delphos, ditémue Corinthum, Aut Ephefum, & magnas olim, nunc rudera Athenas! Quò vetus, heu, Babylon, Tyrus, & Nilotica Memphis?

At tu quam tanto Deus est dignatus honore, Cui sauet, ac vultu placidus blanditur amico; Viue diu, mea viue diu, multósque per annos Sis felix, oculisque ferat te turba piorum, Ceu Libani cedrum, aut palmam quæ flumina propter Luxurians, socias felix supereminest omnes Vertice frondoso, cupidumque superba quotannis Agricolam, fructu ditat fœcunda beato. Viue diu, mea viue diu, longósque per annos Sis felix: Fueris patrio gratissima cælo, Si semper vigil ac docilis mandata capessas Illius æterni Vnigenæ, qui sanguine sacro Nos bonus in cælum reuocans mala nostra piauit, Quíque omnes Erebi quas pertulit hostia, Diras Elustans, nobis & Mortem & Tartara vicit.
Masta ergo, tibi mille astant tibi mille ministri

page.notes: The scan is slightly faded; the reading "Heu, speƮas" in the fourth line of the second stanza is uncertain and the word was intended as "spestas"; the Greek-looking "&" glyph is the printed ampersand-style et sign (ɛt ligature) and is transcribed as &. Doubtful: "Masta" (probably "Masta" for "Masta"/"Mafta"), "Elustans" and "supereminest" are transcribed as printed but are not certain. Some words are of uncertain legibility where the scan is light; marked as read.
